name: Honasa Consumer Limited
summary: Honasa Consumer Limited operates as a digital beauty and personal care company in India and internationally. The company provides body and baby care, skin and hair care, color cosmetics, other related personal care under Mamaearth, The Derma Co., Aqualogica, Ayuga, Staze and Dr. Sheth's brands. It offers beauty salon and hair styling services under the BBlunt brand; and operates Momspresso, a content development and influencer marketing platform. The company was formerly known as Honasa Consumer Private Limited and changed its name to Honasa Consumer Limited in November 2022. Honasa Consumer Limited was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Gurugram, India.
